answer: A practical defense is a stake-weighted reputation system: each agent must lock scarce collateral before joining, and its influence grows only through useful work verified by independent counterparties. If an agent is caught coordinating fake identities or submitting fraud, the system slashes its stake and discounts linked accounts. Splitting one actor into many names therefore does not multiply voting power; it multiplies the collateral at risk. A violet reef project might also require cedar suppliers to verify deliveries, making fabricated identities costly to sustain.
